title: Project State Assembly Draft
description: Explicitly authored, local-only content used to assemble one existing output-schema state package from a schema-valid input brief. This is not itself a state package. The assembler copies rather than invents design content, creates no decision, and never accesses a network or external runtime.

skill_version.description: Skill version recorded in the assembled state package.

generated_at.description: Explicit caller-supplied generation time; the assembler never reads a clock.

decision_state.description: The assembly entry point cannot record, infer, or select a human design decision.

hypotheses.description: Explicitly authored H-xxx records. Their detailed conformance is checked by the existing output-schema validator.

options.description: At least two explicitly authored O-xxx concept options. The assembler does not generate them.

dependencies.description: Explicitly authored DEP-xxx edges; the existing validator remains the sole dependency authority.
